amendment: RESEARCH_RULES_AMENDMENT_V1 (A1 LO20 gate book pre-registered, A2 rolling validation, A3 one model per layer, A4 excess-series cluster test)

books.predictive: overlapping MEAN_FORWARD_RETURN excess vs eligible EW
books.secondary: HN20 hedged (reported only, never the gate)

feature_transform: cross-sectional rank in [0,1] per session over eligible names; names without a live event are NaN (LightGBM missing branch); PA_TYPE / PA_NEG_AGE ties broken by 1e-3 * clipped surprise

hypotheses.mechanism: Earnings pre-announcements (业绩预告/快报) arrive weeks before the formal filing used by V27 and carry the company's own surprise statement (yoy range, type, revenue), its timing (early voluntary disclosure), and the market's first reaction (announcement gap, 3-session drift, abnormal volume). Post-earnings-announcement drift in A-shares is documented to persist for months with slow decay (东方证券 2018 SUE; 天风 2020 净利润断层: 预告 > 正式财报 > 快报). One fitted cross-sectional model on this layer alone. If Level-1 and its excess-vs-EW series is uncorrelated (<= 0.90) with ML1, it is a SECOND independent sleeve.
hypotheses.not: FEATURE_SEARCH; HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH; REFIT_AFTER_RESEARCH; SELECTING_FEATURES_ON_VALIDATION; SWITCHING_BOOK_AFTER_SEEING_HN20; RESTRICTING_UNIVERSE_AFTER_SEEING_RESULTS

independence_test: A4: corr of excess-vs-EW MEAN_FORWARD series vs ML1 (V25 SCORES_ML1_LGBM) and vs V27 ML2F; > 0.90 = SAME_CLUSTER
label: cross-sectional rank of open(t+1)->open(t+1+20) return minus 0.5
level1_gate: fixed-split gates (pred net>0 both, excess/IC evidence>=2 both, FDR q=0.05, LO20 capital>0 research and validation) AND positive excess-vs-EW in >= 4 of 5 rolling blocks
no_search: features, transform, label, params, horizon and schedule fixed here; one run; no second configuration

preann_caveats.express_backfill: ~60% of EXPRESS rows carry NOTICE_DATE > 1 year after period end (re-dated); dropped by the lag rule
preann_caveats.forecast_versions: table keeps only the latest version per (stock, period, line); a revised forecast is seen once at its revision date; conservative

preann_pit: visible from first session strictly after NOTICE_DATE, for <= 120 sessions or until a newer event; notice lag vs period end must be within [-200, 120] days (else IPO back-fill / vendor re-dating, dropped); NOTICE_DATE > 2024-02-29 dropped
preann_source: Eastmoney datacenter RPT_PUBLIC_OP_NEWPREDICT (业绩预告) + RPT_FCI_PERFORMANCEE (业绩快报); free; mirrors exchange filings
universe: all eligible names in the frozen panel (listed, trading, non-ST, >= 40 sessions history); NOT restricted to event names (declared before run)
